 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fb5462ca",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Bivariate data - the basics"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fe0d90c3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "This tutorial focuses on working with paired (bivariate) data using `plans`: loading `x`/`y` samples, inspecting their joint distribution, fitting simple regression models and assessing the model errors."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8968136c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Notebook setup\n",
    "\n",
    "For users running this tutorial as a Jupyter Notebook, this cell must be executed first:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "ed4fcef8",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:04.694429Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:04.694169Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:04.983260Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:04.982858Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Outputs will be saved to: ./outputs\\bivariate\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import sys\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "# Install `plans` in `google.colab`.\n",
    "# Use `pip install plans` for other environments.\n",
    "\n",
    "if \"google.colab\" in sys.modules:\n",
    "    import os\n",
    "    os.system(f\"{sys.executable} -m pip install -q plans\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# This avoids warnings related to uninstalled fonts\n",
    "import logging\n",
    "# Set the matplotlib font manager logger to only show errors (hides warnings)\n",
    "logging.getLogger('matplotlib.font_manager').setLevel(logging.ERROR)\n",
    "\n",
    "# define output folder\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR = Path(\"outputs/bivariate\")\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "print(f\"Outputs will be saved to: ./{OUTPUT_DIR}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c01b6efd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## The `Bivar` object\n",
    "\n",
    "The `Bivar` object lives under the `plans.analyst` module. Like `Univar`, it is a child of the `DataSet` object from `plans.root`, so it shares the same lifecycle: create the object, feed it data, and let `.update()` refresh the derived attributes.\n",
    "\n",
    "```{seealso}\n",
    "Check out the {doc}`Univariate data - the basics <univar_01>` tutorial first.\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "229d8ced",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Import `Bivar` object:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "9fa5ab57",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:04.984840Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:04.984642Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.260473Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.260058Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from plans.analyst import Bivar"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "73e4c57e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Create an instance of the `Bivar`:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "728ad8b9",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.262830Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.262602Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.268848Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.268243Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "bv = Bivar(name=\"Rating Curve\", alias=\"RC\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9a26f6ff",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Check out the variable type:"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "f698f2f2",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {

    }

     "text": [
      "<class 'plans.analyst.Bivar'>\n"

   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "283529c7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Handle data attributes"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5657bdf1",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Columns are named by `.xfield` and `.yfield`, while `.xname`, `.yname`, `.xunits` and `.yunits` are only used as labels in visuals and metadata. Set labels **before** loading data, so the axis labels are built from them:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "d37457db",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.275239Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.274972Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.278436Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.278029Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "x column: x | y column: y\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "bv.description = \"Stage-discharge pairs for a tutorial\"\n",
    "bv.xname = \"Stage\"\n",
    "bv.xunits = \"m\"\n",
    "bv.yname = \"Discharge\"\n",
    "bv.yunits = \"m3/s\"\n",
    "print(f\"x column: {bv.xfield} | y column: {bv.yfield}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d572d121",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Working with data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2b33c09d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Create synthetic power-law dataset\n",
    "\n",
    "Stage-discharge relations (rating curves) are a classic bivariate case in hydrology. Lets make a synthetic one following a power law plus gaussian noise, shuffle the rows and add a couple of missing values, then save it to a CSV file."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "5a91d023",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.279971Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.279760Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.308766Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.308397Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Saved to: outputs\\bivariate\\bivariate_rating.csv\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "<div>\n",
       "<style scoped>\n",
       "    .dataframe tbody tr th:only-of-type {\n",

       "    }\n",
       "\n",

       "      <td>NaN</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th>4</th>\n",

       "  </tbody>\n",
       "</table>\n",

      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "      stage  discharge\n",
       "0  1.693467  10.167719\n",
       "1  0.688442   1.892135\n",
       "2  0.876884   6.193725\n",
       "3  2.484925        NaN\n",
       "4  2.108040  15.848562"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 6,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# make synthetic power-law data\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)  # ensure reproducibility\n",
    "h = np.linspace(start=0.5, stop=3.0, num=200)\n",
    "q = 5 * np.power(h, 1.6) + rng.normal(loc=0, scale=1, size=len(h))\n",
    "df = pd.DataFrame({\"stage\": h, \"discharge\": q})\n",
    "\n",
    "# shuffle rows and add missing values\n",
    "df = df.sample(frac=1, random_state=42).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "df.loc[[3, 7], \"discharge\"] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "# Export CSV file\n",
    "file_csv = OUTPUT_DIR / \"bivariate_rating.csv\"\n",
    "df.to_csv(file_csv, sep=\";\", index=False)\n",
    "print(f\"Saved to: {file_csv}\")\n",
    "df.head()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "38b2f124",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Loading data from the CSV file"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b0d901a2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Call the `.load_data()` method, pointing which file columns hold `x` and `y`. They are renamed to `.xfield` and `.yfield` on loading:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "22026ebf",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.310480Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.310235Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.322453Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.321743Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "bv.load_data(\n",
    "    file_data=file_csv,  # file path\n",
    "    input_xfield=\"stage\",  # name of x column\n",
    "    input_yfield=\"discharge\",  # name of y column\n",
    "    in_sep=\";\",  # input separator\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "### Fine-tuning visuals\n",
    "\n",
    "Like other `plans` objects, use the `.view_specs` keys for fine tuning:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "449cbb6f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.462629Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.462369Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.571970Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.571559Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 318.898x314.961 with 3 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "bv.view_specs[\"color\"] = \"tab:blue\"\n",
    "bv.view_specs[\"bins\"] = 15  # default None uses the Freedman-Diaconis rule\n",
    "bv.view_specs[\"plot_mean\"] = False\n",
    "bv.view_specs[\"title\"] = \"Hello! This is a tutorial!\"\n",
    "bv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "73431e36",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Fitting models"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9fa1de4d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Available models\n",
    "\n",
    "Models are stored in the `.models` dictionary. Each entry holds the function, its formula, a `Setup` table of parameters and, once computed, the model `Data` and the `RMSE`:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "4aa277c2",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.573798Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.573634Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.576641Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.576210Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Linear       f(x) = c0 + c1 * x\n",
      "Power        f(x) =  c2 * ((x + c0)^c1)\n",
      "Power_zero   f(x) =  c1 * (x^c0)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "for model_type, model in bv.models.items():\n",
    "    print(f\"{model_type:<12} {model['Formula']}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b926958e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Fit a model\n",
    "\n",
    "The `.fit()` method runs a least squares fit and stores the mean and standard deviation of parameters in the `Setup` table:"
   ]
  },
  {

   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "bc2c6205",
   "metadata": {

    }
   },

    {

    "bv.fit(model_type=\"Power\")\n",

   ]
  },

   "id": "c828d410",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fac68113",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Compare models\n",
    "\n",
    "Fit all models and compare their RMSE:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "d296482b",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.801672Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.801517Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.808351Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.807903Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Linear       RMSE = 1.337\n",
      "Power        RMSE = 0.878\n",
      "Power_zero   RMSE = 0.881\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "for model_type in bv.models:\n",
    "    bv.fit(model_type=model_type)\n",
    "    print(f\"{model_type:<12} RMSE = {bv.models[model_type]['RMSE']:.3f}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c765e708",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Set parameters manually\n",
    "\n",
    "Parameters can also be set by hand with `.update_model()`, for instance to test a known reference curve:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "id": "70f37d48",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.809758Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.809544Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.813873Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.813293Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "RMSE = 1.589\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "bv.update_model(params_mean=[1.5, 5.0], model_type=\"Power_zero\")\n",
    "print(f\"RMSE = {bv.models['Power_zero']['RMSE']:.3f}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ffb33029",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Model assessment"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "031c018f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Model panel\n",
    "\n",
    "Set the `model` layout and the `model_type` key to get the model panel. It shows the fitted curve, how the error variance evolves along `x`, the errors, their histogram and a Q-Q plot against the normal distribution:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "id": "1f39cc85",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.815295Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:05.815139Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:06.236529Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:06.236155Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 472.441x314.961 with 5 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "bv.fit(model_type=\"Power\")\n",
    "bv.view_specs[\"layout\"] = \"model\"\n",
    "bv.view_specs[\"model_type\"] = \"Power\"\n",
    "bv.view_specs[\"title\"] = \"Power model\"\n",
    "bv.view()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "86871991",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

    "\n",

    "execution": {

     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:06.264128Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3776ae86",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Goodness-of-fit metrics\n",
    "\n",
    "Static methods are available for common metrics between predicted and observed values:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 20,
   "id": "16cf9708",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-30T15:12:06.265939Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-30T15:12:06.265783Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-30T15:12:06.269186Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-30T15:12:06.268784Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "RMSE: 0.878\n",
      "MAE: 0.709\n",
      "R2: 0.988\n",
      "Bias (%): 0.008\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "df_model = bv.models[\"Power\"][\"Data\"]\n",
    "pred = df_model[f\"{bv.yfield}_Mean\"].values\n",
    "obs = df_model[bv.yfield].values\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"RMSE: {Bivar.rmse(pred=pred, obs=obs):.3f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"MAE: {Bivar.mae(pred=pred, obs=obs):.3f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"R2: {Bivar.rsq(pred=pred, obs=obs):.3f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Bias (%): {Bivar.bias(pred=pred, obs=obs):.3f}\")"
   ]
  }
